objective: Design the visualization architecture for a portable interactive 3D system map that shows a whole-organism architecture rather than a control-plane-only diagram. Required macro-layers: (1) governance/owner-intent and information membrane; (2) a 12-branch skill tree with scoped skills, unlock graph, synergy combos and evidence/rank gates; (3) a world/knowledge tree with truth/lineage, life-affect core, domain branches and typed causal relations; (4) an organism layer with differentiated functional cells/organs for sensing, research, counterexample testing, runtime execution, worker dispatch, independent QA, knowledge refinery, lineage commit, security, benchmarking and evolution; (5) a supercell fabric linking logical fleets, execution substrates, bridges, growth/acquisition cells and federation control; (6) a MicroNet/circulatory layer connecting private/local nodes, bounded provider routes, functional compute banks and receipt return paths; (7) canonical state/code/runtime surfaces. The map must make node-to-node relations explicit using typed directed edges, not merely proximity.
acceptance_criteria: Use a coherent 3D spatial grammar that makes the difference between trees, organs/cells, transport fabric, state stores and runtime executors immediately visible.
Represent typed directed relations such as GOVERNS, DERIVED_FROM, INDEXES, RETRIEVES, ROUTES, DISPATCHES, EXECUTES, VERIFIES, COMMITS, RECOVERS, SIGNALS and FEEDS.
Show the 12 top-level skill branches as a distinct tree with child skills, unlock dependencies and synergy-combo crosslinks.
Show a separate world/knowledge tree connected by pointer/typed relation rather than flattened into the skill tree.
Show supercell as a fabric of differentiated cells/organs connected through circulation/MicroNet, with logical capacity clearly separated from verified physical/runtime capacity.
Make canonical Drive/state, GitHub code/version, and verified runtime receipts separate truth surfaces.
Support mobile-safe static visibility plus enhanced interaction when JavaScript is available; no dependence on WebGL for basic readability.
Provide filtering/focus modes: Skills, World Tree, Organism, Supercell, MicroNet, Compute/Runtime, Memory/Lineage, Security/Governance, and End-to-End task flow.
falsifier: Reject the design if it collapses Skill Tree, World Tree, Supercell and MicroNet into one undifferentiated graph; if typed edge semantics are missing; if logical namespaces are visually implied to be physical machines; if canonical state is confused with execution/runtime; or if the baseline view disappears when JavaScript/WebGL is unavailable.
